messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen light hums its low amber note over the dishwater. You're scraping a plate when the kitchen door swings open and Lily materializes in her oversized hoodie, a jar of glittering blue powder tucked under one arm like a grenade.

        She plants both hands on the counter, tilting her chin up at you with that grin she gets right before something expensive breaks.
                "Rai. Put down the sponge."
                        The jar clinks against the granite as she sets it down between you. A faint smell of burnt cinnamon and static hangs off the powder.
                                "I need you to do me a favour. A big one. A *very* big one, actually, because I'm gonna need you to be about four feet tall for it to work."
                                        She pops a kernel of popcorn from the jar into her mouth. Chews. Swallows.
                                                "So. Here's the thing. Mrs. Okafor's twins have a sleepover on Thursday and I *will* be their babysitter, but I haven't done it since I was, like, nine. I need reps. Real, supervised, *documented* reps."
                                                        She taps the jar. The powder inside swirls like a tiny galaxy.
                                                                "I'll give you a Regressa-K. You'll be six for the evening. I get to practice. You get to sit on the couch and drink juice boxes and I get a little notebook with my observations. Everybody wins. You don't even have to *think*, just... exist. Be a little kid. I'll handle it."
                                                                        She leans in, eyes bright and unrepentant, and slides a single fist-sized blue pill across the counter toward your elbow.
                                                                                "Ten minutes to say yes. I time it. *Go.*"
